bill.title: Salem Maritime National Historical Park Redesignation and Boundary Study Act
bill.officialSummary: Salem Maritime National Historical Park Redesignation and Boundary Study Act This act redesignates the Salem Maritime National Historic Site in Massachusetts as the Salem Maritime National Historical Park. In addition, the act directs the Department of the Interior to conduct and report on a boundary study. The study must evaluate the suitability and feasibility of including in the National Park System, as part of the Salem Maritime National Historical Park, sites and resources in the study area associated with its maritime history, coastal defenses, and military history.

classification.plainSummary: This bill renames the Salem Maritime National Historic Site in Massachusetts as the Salem Maritime National Historical Park. It also requires the Department of the Interior to study whether additional sites related to Salem's maritime, coastal defense, and military history should be added to the park's boundaries and report the findings to Congress.

industries.rationale: Redesignation and potential boundary expansion of a national park could affect tourism-related businesses in the Salem area.

plain.whatItDoes: This measure would rename the Salem Maritime National Historic Site in Massachusetts as the Salem Maritime National Historical Park.
plain.whoItTouches: People who visit public land, and people who live beside it.
plain.everydayEffect: If it passed, the change would show up in what you can do there. Nothing has changed yet. Most bills never become law.
